device_entry.description: 用于实验数据流程中的非物理软件规则组件。它表示一种本地定位处理规则，用于在数据采集或本地缓存完成后触发定位分析相关流程，并提供总帧数、数据完成状态等规则状态信息。
device_entry.description_en: A non-physical software rule component used in experimental data workflows. It represents a local localization processing rule that can trigger localization-analysis-related steps after acquisition or local spooling is complete, and exposes rule status such as total frame count and data completion state.

schema.description: 在数据完成时触发本地定位处理规则
schema.description_en: trigger the local localization processing rule when data is complete
